title: Walking with a Different Goal
fact_notes: オリジナル教材。人物、出来事は架空の例。実在の調査、実証結果、制度、個別医療の助言ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A group of friends decides to walk together in a park every Saturday morning.
sentences.ja: 友人グループは毎週土曜朝に公園で一緒に歩くことを決める。

sentences.en: They choose a long route because they believe that completing a greater distance will make the activity more satisfying.
sentences.ja: 長い距離を完了する方が満足できると思い長い経路を選ぶ。

sentences.en: One member, Lina, finds the pace uncomfortable and begins to worry about joining the group the following week.
sentences.ja: 一人のリナは速さが快適でなく翌週の参加を心配し始める。

sentences.en: She enjoys spending time with her friends, but she does not share their interest in walking as far as possible.
sentences.ja: 友人との時間は楽しいができる限り遠く歩くことへの関心は共有しない。

sentences.en: The friends discuss what they hope to gain from their weekly activity.
sentences.ja: 友人は毎週の活動から何を得たいか議論する。

sentences.en: Some enjoy challenging themselves, while others mainly appreciate the opportunity to be outdoors and talk with people.
sentences.ja: 自分に挑戦するのを楽しむ人もいれば主に屋外で話す機会をありがたく思う人もいる。

sentences.en: Lina explains that a shorter walk with enough time to rest would be more enjoyable for her.
sentences.ja: 休む十分な時間のある短い散歩の方が楽しいと説明する。

sentences.en: The group recognizes that a common activity can serve different purposes.
sentences.ja: 共通活動が異なる目的に役立つと認識する。

sentences.en: They decide to meet at the same place but offer two possible routes.
sentences.ja: 同じ場所で会うが二つの経路を設けると決める。

sentences.en: Each person can choose a route according to their own circumstances instead of feeling required to follow the fastest walker.
sentences.ja: 最も速い人に従う必要を感じず各自の事情に応じ経路を選べる。

sentences.en: They arrange to meet again at a café after the walk.
sentences.ja: 散歩後カフェで再会するよう手配する。

sentences.en: This change allows them to share the social part of the activity without requiring everyone to complete an identical journey.
sentences.ja: 変更により全員に同一の移動を求めず活動の社会的部分を共有できる。

sentences.en: The imaginary group does not attempt to determine the appropriate amount of exercise for each individual.
sentences.ja: 架空グループは各個人の適切な運動量を決定しようとしない。

sentences.en: Actual exercise needs can differ according to a person's health and other circumstances.
sentences.ja: 実際の運動の必要は健康状態その他の事情に応じ異なり得る。

sentences.en: The friends simply learn to discuss their preferences rather than use distance as the only measure of success.
sentences.ja: 友人は単に距離を唯一の成功尺度とせず好みを議論することを学ぶ。

sentences.en: They also realize that an activity can become more welcoming when different ways of participating are available.
sentences.ja: 異なる参加方法が利用可能なら活動はより受け入れやすくなり得るとも気づく。

sentences.en: A shared goal does not always require an identical routine.
sentences.ja: 共通目標は常に同じ日課を必要としない。

sentences.en: People may value different aspects of the same experience.
sentences.ja: 同じ体験の異なる側面を重視することがある。

sentences.en: Recognizing those differences can help a group make arrangements that allow more people to participate comfortably.
sentences.ja: 違いを認識するとより多くの人が快適に参加できる手配を助けられる。

sentences.en: For these friends, a successful morning becomes one that everyone can enjoy in their own way.
sentences.ja: 友人にとって成功した朝は全員が自分なりに楽しめる朝になる。

questions.prompt: Why is Lina worried about joining again?
options: She has already chosen a longer route.
The pace is uncomfortable for her.
A race against the fastest walker.
A shorter walk with time to rest.
A different activity with no friends.
Everyone wants exactly the same challenge.
Distance is the only possible goal.
People can have different goals within the same activity.
Talking is not part of a social activity.
questions.explanation_ja: 同じ活動の異なる目的。

questions.prompt: What change does the group make?
options: Meet together but offer two routes.

questions.prompt: Why meet at a café afterward?
options: To share the social experience despite different walks.
To make everyone walk the same distance.
To choose only one fastest walker.

questions.prompt: What does the group not determine?
options: Whether the meeting can include social time.
Appropriate exercise amounts for every individual.
questions.explanation_ja: 個別運動量は決定しない。

questions.prompt: Why offer different ways of taking part?
options: It removes every possible need for rest.
It can make the activity more welcoming.
It prevents friends from spending time together.
A regular way of doing something.
Everyone must exercise at the same pace.
Shared activities can accommodate different needs and goals.
The longest walk is necessarily best.
A group cannot enjoy different routines.
questions.explanation_ja: 共通活動と個別の必要。
